name: Lich Lords
detailed_description:
Lich Lords is a dark fantasy ARPG dungeon crawler set in a purgatory-like realm, where an eternal struggle rages among the undead. Countless Lich battle for dominance, seeking to ascend to the ultimate status of Lich Lord, ruler of the dimension.

As one of many aspiring Lich, you must descend into the deepest, most eldritch dungeons of the realm, eliminating rival Lich and the horrific, nightmarish creatures that lurk in the shadows. Only by surviving the relentless onslaught can you claim the throne and become the Lich Lord. But your reign will be fleeting—once crowned, a new cycle begins, and an endless legion of challengers will rise, all seeking to dethrone you and seize power for themselves.

Lich Lords blends roguelike dungeon crawling with the punishing combat of souls-like games, combined with the fast-paced action of classic hack 'n' slash ARPGs. You’ll likely create and control countless new Lich, experiment with different classes, acquire unique loot and skills, and die repeatedly—until you finally rise as the one true Lich Lord.

Key Features:

  • Roguelike Gameplay – Every run is unique, with randomized dungeons, enemy Lich, monsters, and an expansive pool of customizable loot. No two playthroughs are the same.

  • Customizable Campaigns – Tweak campaign settings to craft your ideal experience, adjusting parameters like total enemy Lich amount, damage multipliers, dungeon themes, and more.

  • Third Person & Top-Down Camera - Dynamically switch in real time between a top down camera view as seen in traditional ARPG style games, or a more modern third person RPG camera style

  • Online Play – Inspired by souls-like multiplayer mechanics, players can join your timeline to aid in co-op battles or invade your realm to alter it's destiny by ending your conquest in PvP

  • Exploration & Discovery – Traverse a haunting variety of dungeon environments, from gothic castles and ancient ruins to overgrown cities, each with randomized layouts and unpredictable horrors waiting around every corner.

  • Terrifying Enemies – Rival Lich are not your only threat. Face nightmarish creatures, grotesque humanoids, and eldritch beasts that can end your run in an instant.

  • Deep Character Customization – Personalize your Lich’s appearance, class, and starting items, then build your perfect warrior by upgrading stats, acquiring powerful gear, and refining your combat style.

Only one Lich can reign supreme. Will it be you?
